description: common/mod.rs submission_matches_condition (~lines 1637-1649): identity_ids, email_ids, and thread_ids are all Option<Vec<Id>> (from EmailSubmissionFilterCondition in jmap-mail-types/src/submission.rs). The .contains() call on a Vec is O(list_len). For a query scanning M submissions where each filter check calls contains() on three lists of size N, the filter pass is O(M*N). Since these are membership tests, the type should be Option<HashSet<Id>> or the caller should convert Vec to HashSet once before iterating. At production scale (thousands of submissions, filter lists of tens of IDs) this matters.
title: submission_matches_condition: Vec::contains on id filter lists
